title: Elevator trip
prompt: An elevator starts at floor 0 and visits the requested floors in the given order (floors may be negative). Moving from floor a to floor b travels |a - b| floors. A request for the floor the elevator is already on does not move it. Each move goes up or down; count a direction change whenever a move goes in the opposite direction of the previous move (the first move is never a change, and requests that do not move the elevator are ignored for this). Return pair(total floors travelled, number of direction changes).
